exposure: indications for prenatal diagnostic genetic amniocentesis (e.g., major fetal structural anomalies)
outcome: types of genetic aberrations detected (e.g., Down syndrome, Edward syndrome, Di-George syndrome, Duchenne muscular dystrophy)
cohort: A total of 159 Ethiopian pregnant women with specific indications for genetic testing who underwent prenatal diagnostic genetic amniocentesis.
finding: Diagnostic prenatal genetic testing in a Sub-Saharan African setting successfully identified both common (trisomy 21 & 18) and rare genetic defects among Ethiopian pregnant women.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from January 2017 to April 2023.
